summary: Iteration 11: Verified print settings (print_paper_mm, print_width_mm, print_offset_mm, print_scale, print_feed_mm) across backend and frontend. Backend GET returns defaults (80/72/0/100/6); PUT rejects out-of-range (width>paper, offset 25, scale 30, feed 50) with 400 and accepts valid values (80/68/2/90/8) which persist. Frontend Settings paper-preview correctly reflects width 68mm (~257px), paper 80mm (~302px), margin-left 8mm (~30px), inner card zoom 0.9. Save shows success toast 'Pengaturan berhasil disimpan'; values persist after reload. btn-test-print stubbed window.print → 1 card rendered in #print-root [data-testid='settings-test-print'] with <style>@page{size:80mm auto}. Kelola Voucher individual print (btn-print-<CODE>) uses saved settings: card width=68mm, marginLeft=8mm, @page 80mm auto. No console errors on Settings/Vouchers pages. Defaults restored (72/0/100/6) at end.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.js: printPayload spreads all form fields as-is including strings; expiry_warning_days may still be string on first GET-init but parseInt handles it. Consider narrowing PUT payload to only expected fields.
PrintVoucher.js: uses CSS `zoom` property which is not supported in Firefox for print output; consider CSS transform:scale as fallback for wider browser compatibility.
Settings.js: 'Pengaturan Cetak' preview PrintVoucher renders twice on page (in preview + inside PrintPortal) which duplicates a QR image render; acceptable but note performance.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing vouchers for Kelola Voucher print test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Print settings feature works end-to-end. Notes for future flaky tests: Settings.js loads defaults synchronously (DEFAULT_SETTINGS) then fetches /api/settings via useEffect and setForm; wait for the fetched value to appear in inputs (not just for the selector) before reading. Use page.wait_for_function on the input value. Also use focus+Ctrl+A+Delete+type for number inputs; page.fill may occasionally be flaky with shadcn number inputs. Bulk 3-voucher PDF page-count verification was not executed via headless PDF; browser was used only for print-portal DOM assertions (cards + @page style) which matches the 'auto cut per page' guarantee.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. One test iteration initially failed due to reading form values before the async GET /api/settings resolved; resolved by polling input.value with wait_for_function.
